data.desc: 1st Source common stock is traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under 'SRCE' and appears in the National Market System tables in many daily newspapers under the code name '1st Src.' Since 1863, 1st Source has been committed to the success of its clients, individuals, businesses and the communities it serves. 1st Source serves the northern half of Indiana and southwest Michigan and is the largest locally controlled financial institution headquartered in the area. While delivering a comprehensive range of consumer and commercial banking services through its community bank offices, 1st Source has distinguished itself with highly personalized services. 1st Source Bank also competes for business nationally by offering specialized financing services for new and used private and cargo aircraft, automobiles for leasing and rental agencies, medium and heavy-duty trucks, and construction equipment.
